sources.label: Morphe patches to remove ads, analytics, apk junk, debug info, duplicate graphic
sources.author: BlazeFTL
patch_list: Hides the Download tools and Phone clean categories, and their sub-items, from Settings.
Turns off the Toolbar, Recommended contents, and Tool notifications channels by default.
Strips the LinkHandleActivity alias's unscoped so the app stops appearing as a candidate in the system's default browser / "open with" chooser.
Removes the requirement to watch a rewarded ad before a download starts.
